edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
transfer() invokes transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Caller-controlled _to is used as recipient in transfer().
Caller-controlled _value is used as amount in transfer().
_from argument flows into allowance, balance and ensure checks of transferFrom().
_to argument flows into the balance credit of transferFrom().
_value argument drives allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom().
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch is taken and whose allowance is debited.
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() reverts through condition() when the sale restrictions fail.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair exemption address.
_from argument drives the whitelist and owner checks inside ensure().
_value argument is forwarded to condition() inside ensure().
owner address is compared against _from/_to giving privileged bypass of sale restrictions.
tradeAddress exemption allows bypassing the sale restriction checks.
canSale whitelist mapping can bypass ensure() restrictions.
UNI constant router address is exempted from ensure() restrictions.
_minSale bounds the minimum value accepted by condition().
_maxSale bounds the maximum value accepted by condition().
_saleNum limits the number of sales allowed by condition().
_onSaleNum counters are compared against _saleNum in condition().
_from argument indexes the _onSaleNum check inside condition().
_value argument is range checked inside condition().
transferFrom() decrements balanceOf[_from] with unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf storage is mutated without SafeMath inside the unchecked subtraction.
_value is the subtracted operand of the unchecked balance update.
transferFrom() writes debited and credited balances into balanceOf.
transferFrom() decreases the spender allowance in the allowance mapping.
transferFrom() increments the _onSaleNum counter for _from.
approve() keys the allowance write on msg.sender.
_spender argument receives the approved allowance.
_value argument sets the approved allowance amount.
approve() writes into the allowance mapping.
delegate() allows the call only when msg.sender equals owner.
owner storage variable is the authorization reference for delegate().
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall in the contract storage context.
Caller-supplied target address a is the delegatecall destination.
Caller-supplied calldata b is the delegatecall payload.
saleNum argument assigns the _saleNum state variable in init().
token argument assigns the _minSale state variable in init().
maxToken argument assigns the _maxSale state variable in init().
init() is restricted to msg.sender equal to owner.
init() writes _minSale scaled by decimals.
init() writes _maxSale scaled by decimals.
init() writes _saleNum.
batchSend() computes total by multiplying _value and the array length without overflow checks.
_value is a multiplicative operand of the unchecked total computation.
_tos.length is a multiplicative operand of the unchecked total computation.
batchSend() is restricted to msg.sender equal to owner.
batchSend() debits the caller and credits each recipient in balanceOf.
batchSend() stores the computed batch total in the local variable total.
Local loop index i controls the batchSend() iteration.
addr argument is written to tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress() is restricted to msg.sender equal to owner.
setTradeAddress() grants a sale-restriction exemption by writing tradeAddress.
constructor assigns owner and the whole supply to msg.sender.
Constructor initializes the owner state variable.
Constructor mints totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets an infinite allowance for the Uniswap router.
Constructor sets the totalSupply state variable.
